invented.quote: The 9 new clinics made up for that revenue, which is why monthly revenue stayed flat instead of falling.
invented.why: The brief does not state the revenue from the 9 new clinics or the other 3 lost clinics, nor does it preclude expansion revenue from existing customers, so it cannot be known that the 9 new clinics alone offset the losses.

invented.quote: For larger groups, a basic scheduler that comes free with their records system is a real competitor.
invented.why: The brief only states that the scheduler is 'built into their electronic records system' and does not say whether it comes free or is basic.

invented.quote: It also works no matter which scheduler a clinic uses.
invented.why: The brief only states that the reminder feature will be sold on its own, not that it integrates or works with any scheduler on the market.

invented.quote: This lets us sell to clinics that are committed to their records system's scheduler, including groups like the chain we just lost, without having to replace that scheduler.
invented.why: The brief does not mention the reason for selling the reminder feature on its own or whether it can be used alongside an existing records system's scheduler.
